blocks.title: NP-hard
blocks.text: NP-hard masail kam az kam NP ke sab se mushkil masail jitne mushkil hain. In ke liye koi kaarkard algorithm maloom nahi, aur yeh aam taur par zyada bare na hone wale cases mein bhi bohat waqt lete hain.
Travelling Salesman Problem NP-hard hai: koi maloom algorithm ise bohat se shehron ke liye jaldi hal nahi karta, kyunke raaston ki tadaad factorial ke hisab se barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar computer ek second mein ek arab raaste jaanche to 20 shehron ke liye taqreeban kitna waqt lagega?
blocks.explanation: 2.43 x 10^18 / 10^9 = 2.43 x 10^9 seconds, taqreeban 77 saal, jo dikhata hai ke mukammal brute force kyun na-qabil-e-amal hai.

items: NP-hard: kam az kam NP ke mushkil tareen masail jitna; TSP raaste: 5 shehar 120, 10 shehar 3,628,800, 20 shehar taqreeban 2.43 x 10^18.
